title: Cordyceps@LT-EDI: Patching Language-Specific Homophobia/Transphobia Classifiers with a Multilingual Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (via F1-scores) on correctly classifying homophobic hate speech and dogwhistles using the Shared Task on Homophobia/Transphobia Detection in social media comments dataset.
Evaluating model performance (via F1-scores) on correctly classifying transphobic hate speech and anti-trans rhetoric in social media comments.
Comparing classifier performance disparities across five languages (English, Hindi, Malayalam, Spanish, Tamil) to identify and mitigate the performance drop in low-resource and non-English languages.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
